messages:
lara (product): Customer event: small mobile SDK customer asks for an "Optimize Advisor" that recommends batching, cache TTL, and a best-fit quant profile. Needs a purge API and alerting on quality regressions. Can we scope a tight alpha?
kevin (eng): We can scope small: advisor service returns recommendations only (no auto-enforce). Runtime will expose a fallback flag. Batching cap for mobile should default to 1-4.
jules (ml): We'll provide two quant profiles: edge-safe (higher fidelity) and edge-lean (smaller). We'll validate both on customer eval slices and report deltas.
tara (devex): SDK changes: recommendConfig() + purgeLocalCache() and lightweight telemetry hooks. Docs + example in 1 sprint if scoped.
lara (product): Proposed alpha gate: 1) recommender latency < 250ms (emulator), 2) edge-safe regression <= 2.5% on customer eval, 3) console alert if concordance drops >3% over 24h.
kevin (eng): Rollout: feature-flagged advisor, customer opt-in, canary quant pool. If alert fires twice in 12h -> route to stable binary and flip fallback. ops-bot, can you auto-create a ticket on rollback?
ops-bot: Rule added: 2 rollbacks in 12h -> create ticket and notify oncall.
jules (ml): Measurement note: device metrics noisy; we'll combine sampled device telemetry with server replays for alerts. Also recommend token-level concordance + task accuracy as signals.
tara (devex): Purge endpoint: POST /sdk/v1/cache/purge {tenant_id, keys?}. We'll require auth and rate limits. Client helper: purgeLocalCache().
kevin (eng): Rough effort: advisor service 2w, quant validation + canary infra 4w, SDK + purge 1w, observability rules 1w. Target alpha in 5 weeks.
lara (product): Thumbs? :thumbsup:?
kevin (eng): :thumbsup: pending infra support for kernels.
jules (ml): :thumbsup: ML will deliver profiles and harness.
tara (devex): :thumbsup: will draft SDK PR.
lara (product): Scheduling a 30m sync Tue 11am to finalize scope and pilot customers. ops-bot: flag OPTIMIZE-ADVISOR-479999 (owner: lara).
